decisive_spans.text: Multiple echogenic targets with snowflake appearance in all four heart chambers

response.rationale: The presence of 'Elevated tumor markers' and 'Multiple echogenic targets with snowflake appearance in all four heart chambers' strongly supports Cancer-associated thrombosis. While D1 (Disseminated intravascular coagulation) has support from elevated D-dimer and fibrinogen, it is contradicted by negative procoagulant studies. D4 (Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura) is also contradicted by negative procoagulant studies. D3 (Dehydration-Induced Venous Thromboembolism) has weaker support compared to D2.
